bottleneck.summary: Explicit softening, q/k sampling, residual force/stress, harmonic scalar/noSOC approximation and ordered/disordered competitors assessed. No retained dominant contradiction reverses the bounded preliminary inference; magnetic/SOC/thermodynamic/coherence tests remain falsifiable follow-ups.

Residual maxstress0.502GPa/force0.02436eV-A and no global hull/synthesis proof remain stated.

proposed_contribution.next_action: Matched reciprocal-resolution and competing-order tests will distinguish stable geometry/EPC benefit from sampling/softening. Maintain only if paired benefit and feasible modes survive; reduce support if gain vanishes or an instability/competing state dominates; ambiguous results retain hypothesis rather than forced acceptance.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
